challenge.better_approach: Two narrower options I looked at. (a) Drop the bounds carry entirely: that would re-cast a red-first proof's own red every run while its ticket is building it, which D3 of 207c4074b3d5 exists to stop. (b) Carry by bounds only for tickets cast by the tester itself: those already use fixes, so the bounds carry would vanish for hand-cast tickets building red-first proofs, which is the case it serves. Carrying exactly the declared teeth keeps D3's case and drops the unrelated ones.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a ticket building a red-first proof declares the red teeth under its own id in PROVES before the red fires. That holds by construction (the proof's PROVES is what makes it red-first for that ticket). A ticket that bounds a proof for some other reason (fb42e9a6842f, open at TICKETME, writes a record fixture inside test_rehearsal) declares nothing there and is not open for its reds. Also assumed: a '*' red (no tooth named) is carried by any declaring bounding ticket, since there is no tooth to compare.
challenge.prior_art: 207c4074b3d5 (PROVED) built the dedupe; its clause 3 holds 'a red whose proof an open ticket names in bounds.in casts nothing' over a fixture proof that declares no PROVES, so that tooth changes here, and the decision rides this ticket. c420501acb0b is the hand cast of the swallowed red. Grep of the tickets for carried/dedup/per-tooth finds no other ticket on the bounds carry.
challenge.real_collision: 207c4074b3d5 clause 3 and D3, really: same component, opposite outcomes on one fixture. Not exclusive: D3's own why (a red-first proof's ticket carries its own red) is kept exactly; only bounds carrying teeth the ticket does not declare goes, and the outline line's 'open for it' is the deciding text. The decision is recorded in this ticket, and the tooth change rides the same commit.

answers.falsifier: Fixture commons + a red run on proof P tooth T: (1) an open ticket bounds P but neither declares T nor names its key, so one ticket is cast carrying red:P::T; (2) an open ticket bounds P and declares T in P's PROVES, so nothing is cast; (3) an open ticket lists P in fixes, so a red on any tooth casts nothing; (4) two teeth red, one declared by the bounding ticket, so the cast carries only the other's key. Horizon: the next red on a bounded proof is cast by the tester, not by hand.
answers.from_idea: none, because the origin is a measured swallowed red, not an idea: the tester's red-cast door (cairn/devices/tester/red_tickets.py, carried() and ticket_what_is_new) returned cast: [] for a red tooth on cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_rehearsal.py on 2026-11-23, and the red was cast by hand as c420501acb0b
answers.how: In red_tickets.carried(), keep fixes as the per-proof carry (207c4074b3d5 D1: a second tooth on a proof an open ticket fixes is the same repair). Change the bounds.in carry from a path to a set of red keys: an open ticket bounding proof P carries red:P::T only when T is among P's PROVES[ticket id] teeth, or the literal key appears in the ticket, and carries red:P::* when it declares any tooth in P. ticket_what_is_new casts an item with only its uncarried keys. A red-first proof's own red stays carried by the ticket building it, which is D3's stated why.
answers.traces_to: Outline 9.4.2.3.7.5 (reds don't get lost: a ticket for every new red 'unless one is already open for it'). A ticket that only changes a proof is not open for an unrelated tooth of it. Law 7: a red is permanent in the record, and a swallowed cast is a lost red.
answers.what: The tester's red-cast door casts a red tooth that no open ticket is for, even when an open ticket names that tooth's proof in bounds.in; bounds.in carries only the teeth that ticket declares in the proof's PROVES or names by key.

bullets.text: The tester swallowed a red on test_rehearsal today because an open ticket (fb42e9a6842f, at TICKETME) names that proof in bounds.in for an unrelated change. The cast door dedupes bounds by proof path, so the red was cast by hand (c420501acb0b).
The commit message on c420 names 79718ec09198 as the carrier, but that ticket is PROVED and carries nothing. Measured: the open carrier is fb42e9a6842f.
